baseRule: Clean initial-state base. Never paint campaign secrets or their discovery hints into the base.

requirements: Registered to this exact base variant

requiredReview: No clue visible in initial state
No unrelated pixels change on reveal
Unknown viewers receive no feature metadata or layer URLs
campaignSecurity: Instantiate and persist actual secrets on the game server. A public reusable art template is not a private campaign manifest.
generationWorkflow: Author feature bounds on the server-side template
Edit the same base/reference for each feature state
Connect to authoritative checks through the host game adapter
